title: ARTeFACT: Benchmarking Segmentation Models on Diverse Analogue Media Damage
reasoning: The paper focuses on computer vision techniques for detecting and segmenting physical damage in historical artworks and analogue media for the purpose of cultural heritage preservation. While the subjects of the artworks may include religious themes (e.g., frescoes, manuscript miniatures), the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
